name: Bond of Flora, Improved (Floral)
body:
As your bond with nature strengthens, your plant abilities become more instinctive and less taxing to use.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Flora, character level 6th

Benefit(s): Your innate gift for plant magic strengthens, allowing you to use your detect plants and speak with plants spell-like abilities at will.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
